title: Onions and garlic
summary: Use clean planting material, weed control and correct curing for storage bulbs.
steps: Choose seed, sets or cloves suited to local day length and planting season.
Plant in loose drained soil with the top depth recommended for the material.
Keep weed competition low because narrow leaves shade soil poorly.
Reduce irrigation as bulbs mature according to crop condition and local weather.
Harvest when mature, cure in a dry ventilated shaded place and store only firm undamaged bulbs.
